originalQuestion: Investigate GetSharedMemo in this Memos revision. How does a supplied share token bind to the memo that is returned, and which visible controls and exceptions determine access? Compare invalid or expired tokens with a valid token, and distinguish what an unauthenticated caller can obtain from what the same token authorizes around the memo. Read relevant dependencies as needed. Describe source behavior and its limits; no normative policy is supplied.
